description: 各類電信號碼使用情形統計 [telecommunications] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 數位發展部. 本資料集為各類電信號碼使用情形統計及核配現況，內容包含編碼(網路行動碼、可攜網路碼、信號點碼)、識別碼(撥號選接網路識別碼、特殊服務號碼)、用戶號碼(手機號碼、市話號碼、物聯網號碼、網路電話號碼)，提供給資料使用者分析利用。. Coverage: Taiwan. The portal files it under the publisher 數位發展部. Its tags are 交通及通訊. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2025-09-05 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
